notes.title: Charles 1.25
notes.notes:
Day 4 of bug fixes and additions! Here's what we have today:

[list]
[*] Added "Quick Restart" button in options menu (esc or p) for dance battles. Now you can quickly restart mid-song
[*] Changed note offset slider to move in increments of 15ms instead of 20ms
[*] Changed note offset slider to have higher minimum and maximum offset values by 50%
[*] Worldmap music doesn't get restarted everytime you go back and forth to shop
[*] Fixed cutscene for Beela and Beegana being in the wrong order
[*] Added VFX for note chart maker tool
[*] Removed unnecessary stuff in the note chart maker tool
[*] [b]Fixed a really problematic bug that was causing everyone to have issues with progressing, this one is a major fix.[/b]
[*] Fixed the V.I.B items (stink bomb and vitamins) functionality, they weren't working properly before
[*] Added cute Charles art for the sleeping cutscene (more of that stuff coming soon!)
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Pip the God to not unlock after you defeat him
[*] Added graffiti to various dance battle stages
[*] and some more performance improvements, menu alignments, and quality of life stuff
[/list]

Thank ya, love ya. More bug fixes and updates coming August 30th. Including Multiplayeerrrrrrrr

notes.title: Charles 1.20
notes.notes:
Day 3 of crunching on bug fixes! Here's what we got for today!

[list]
[*] removed the note ID numbers, oops!
[*] added text to clarify stuff on the world map
[*] moved custom mode to Extras
[*] added more fan art! Thank you
[*] added more people to special thanks due to more steam reviews! Thank you
[*] added teasers for future content like the airport and multiplayer
[*] fixed Stingmis in her cutscene
[*] improved performance on laptops that have two graphics cards by a lot
[/list]

Thank ya, love ya. More bug fixes and updates coming within 48hrs as more reports and testing get done.

notes.title: Charles 1.15
notes.notes:
Day 2 of crunching on bug fixes! Here's what we got for today!

[list]
[*] fixed steam achievements even more, they don't spam the poor steam servers anymore
[*] fixed custom songs not starting, caused by Note Per Minute value not having a default
[*] fixed note offset not saving to hard drive and cloud saves
[*] pollen gathering pause menu was wrong size
[*] fixed stingmis eyes in versus screen
[*] fixed more gamestate issues, mort will now appear properly and there should be no remaining sequence breaking between cutscenes
[*] fixed missing Devious Mort visual effects
[*] refactored the World Map a bit to be more clear
[/list]

Thank ya, love ya. More bug fixes and updates coming within 48hrs as more reports and testing get done.

notes.title: Charles 1.1
notes.notes:
Welcome to the world post-launch! We're going to start the version numbers over again. Arguably, I should've just had versions 0 to 0.99 as the pre-launch versions. Aww well! Here's some stuff I bug fixed over the first 24 hours of launch. Keep the reports and feedback coming! Thanks!

[list]
[*] fixed steam achievements
[*] fixed free roam mode when going back somewhere you already completed
[*] cleaned up unused files for smaller download size
[*] fixed a blocker that prevented people who own the dlc from playing the dlc content
[*] fixed music continuing to play when going back to menu
[*] fixed taking damage while talking to mort
[*] fixed buzzopolis smoke still being on at night
[*] fixed pip text box not reappearing
[*] fixed top note getting eaten instead of bottom note sometimes
[*] added some sounds
[*] expanded the special thanks to include everyone who left a steam review, thank you!
[/list]

There are lots of bits of bobs that weren't noted. Aiming to improve further and further in the coming days!

notes.title: Charles Version 1.9
notes.notes:
The last update before the launch! Thanks so much for following along and we're excited to show off the full experience. In the meantime, you'll notice some of the changes we've made, many more are behind the scenes in preparation for launch :)

[list]
[*] Changed how sensitive the note timings are. There is a 33% more generous margin of error!
[*] Overhauled arcade menu, added lots of opponents and changed how the decoration works
[*] Added keyboard scrolling for the arcade menu
[*] Revamped the cutscenes and dialogue potions of the game to look better
[*] Added more people to the credits! Thank you for filling out the feedback form :)
[*] Changed the night-time lighting outdoors
[*] Added some functionality for Charles to steer better at night, as long as you're going in the right direction
[/list]

notes.title: Charles Version 1.8
notes.notes:
Getting very close to launch! Two weeks away! Most of the stuff we're working on is behind the scenes. Next week should be a bigger update than this one. :) 

[list]
[*] Credits are more verbose
[*] Changed the "Play" menu
[*] Fixed a bug where the wrong opponent would get chosen on Night 1
[/list]

notes.title: Charles Version 1.7
notes.notes:
​Most of the work this time around was behind the scenes, but things are starting to become finalized. The cutscenes and dialogue stuff have been a huge undertaking. It's looking like we're going to change the way we display text in the game to address a few issues. We'll see y'all in a week for another small content update. Launch is just around the corner!

[list]
[*] Switched Smooth Samuel and Rotten Roger in the story mode
[*] Added Dialogues with the random bees that fly around. Try talking to them by pressing "E"
[/list]

notes.title: Charles Version 1.6
notes.notes:
Hello again! A quick update for y'all. Still working on the big release, with lots of systems coming closer and closer to completion. The art and music are nearly done as well. A November 30th release date looks very strong.

[list]
[*] Added hard mode and easy mode for Arcade and Story!
[*] Changed the scoring system. Streaks/Combos shouldn't matter as much as before (they used to be the only thing that mattered basically)
[*] Changed the letter grade system on the recap screen
[*] Changed art on the title screen for better contrast with interactive elements
[*] Added a "quit to title" button in the options menu
[*] Added note trails
[*] As always, more work is being done behind the scenes. You'll see hints towards that stuff in the game as disabled content
[/list]

notes.title: Charles Version 1.5
notes.notes:
Hello hello! Another medium-sized update. Lots of stuff going on behind the scenes, but some of it is also IN FRONT of the scenes. Here's a list of the stuff that was done this time around. We'll see you all next week for another update.

[list]
[*] Reduced CPU usage of the game by 50%
[*] Shrunk the overworld levels by 20%. This will make it seem like there are more bees and hazards without increasing the amounts.
[*] Added recap screen that shows the breakdown of your performance and your opponent's performance
[*] Changed how wrong-notes are displayed
[*] Added more flowers and pollen to all overworld levels
[*] Added a small cutscene when going into the hive after gathering pollen
[*] Upgraded visuals for boosting
[*] Disabled collisions with bees as an experiment, might bring it back in the future
[*] Lots of work in preparation for future content and full release, of course 😊
[*] Changed some timings on the notes, hopefully, the sync feels better now. Its going to be a bit rough until we get it right, but then its smooth sailing
[*] Fixed a bug with loading day 3 night time
[*] Other small decoration changes on the title screen
[/list]
